c74object.name: j.receive
c74object.description: Subscribe to a model parameter or some other parameter node, and output new value whenever the value of the node change.

inlet.description: Set address of node to listen to

objarg.name: subscription node address
objarg.description: Address of the node that the object will listen to. If no argument is provided, the object will not be subscribing to any node initially.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Ouptut current value for the associated node.
method.description: Ouptut current value for the associated node.

method.name: dump
method.description: The message dumb will output the current value of all attributes for the associated node.

method.name: active
method.digest: Set or query the active attribute
method.description: active 0 or 1 sets the attribute; active alone reports it on the dump outlet.

method.name: address
method.description: Sets the address to listen to. A relative address is taken from the model of the patcher.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Pass a message or set an attribute
method.description: Any other message is passed on, except the names of the attributes, which set the attribute.

attribute.name: active
attribute.description: When the j.return object is active, it will output new values whenever the value of the associated node changes. If j.return is not active, values will only be output when requested by a bang.

attribute.name: address
attribute.description: This sets the address of the associated node that the object will listen to. The address can be absolute and take the form of an OSC address, or relative, in which case the relative address is appended to the address of the j.model or j.view object in the model or view that this j.return object is part of.
